# Good Schemes Examples
# Demonstrates proper scheme structure

# Example 1: Complete scheme with all fields
murder_scheme = {
	skill = intrigue
	desc = murder_scheme_desc
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/schemes/murder.dds"
	category = hostile
	cooldown = { years = 5 }

	is_secret = yes
	base_secrecy = 30

	target_type = character
	is_valid_target = {
		is_alive = yes
	}

	valid_agent = {
		age >= 16
		intrigue >= 8
		NOT = { has_relation_rival = scope:target }
	}

	agent_join_chance = {
		base = 0

		modifier = {
			add = 25
			has_relation_friend = scope:owner
		}

		modifier = {
			add = 50
			has_trait = ambitious
		}
	}

	base_progress_goal = 180

	on_ready = {
		scope:owner = {
			trigger_event = murder.0001
		}
	}

	on_invalidated = {
		scope:owner = {
			trigger_event = murder.invalidated
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		scope:owner = {
			add_intrigue_lifestyle_xp = 10
		}
	}
}

# Example 2: Simple scheme
seduce_scheme = {
	skill = intrigue
	desc = seduce_scheme_desc
	category = personal

	target_type = character
	is_valid_target = {
		is_adult = yes
		is_attracted_to_gender_of = scope:owner
	}

	base_progress_goal = 120

	on_ready = {
		scope:owner = {
			trigger_event = seduction.success
		}

		scope:target = {
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:owner
				modifier = seduced_opinion
			}
		}
	}
}
